payload.subject: Governed Operation from Operator Branches
payload.name: Governed Operation from Operator Branches
payload.purpose: Make SYNTH govern work on pre-existing operator branches: declare and bind execution branches (ADR-056 --branch/--no-create), anchor and single-write the ceremony ledger (ADR-055: ledger writer, anchor, single writer), and make delivery and abandonment first-class ceremonies (deliver/seal/close/abandon) so finished work, files and history survive the branch lifecycle instead of being stranded or wiped.

payload.subject: Branch policy blocks operator-owned branches (evidence: audit 3-12 / 4-R2)
payload.name: Branch policy blocks operator-owned branches (evidence: audit 3-12 / 4-R2)
payload.description: Verified: assertExecutionBranch requires mission/<slug>-<id7>; a workspace pinned to arena/c5db653e-synth is denied every mission approval and expedition start, and the mission branch is demanded but never created (only expedition branches are auto-created, at start). Nothing in the taxonomy lets an existing operator branch be bound to governed work. Remedy: ADR-056 --branch/--no-create with a recorded binding.
